# Wave 5 results and review audit

Final verification of the remaining waves, 25 October 2026. The user authorized autonomous merges. This audit uses the original review as a proposal list, not as proof that every proposal has been implemented.

## Repairs from final verification

- Conditioning priority now invalidates the plan allocation; the program subtitle includes Conditioning.
- Completed activities open an activity record instead of a missing workout host. Recent records are available in Progress.
- An existing activity timer is resumed rather than silently attached to a second planned part. Ending a day asks for actual activity minutes before saving.
- Unlimited-time plans no longer inherit a hidden conditioning time cap. Alternating intervals credit the hard/easy segments actually logged.
- Goal trends use distinct calendar days and reject stale observations for future projections. Section-specific Progress filters can open the goal form.
- The screenshot repair remains covered: active list mode hides the header, bottom navigation and Together strip; Next set sits with session controls; a long-open workout shows its start date.

## Verification

Validation: 209 Node tests and 519 browser assertions across 11 suites pass, with syntax and generated-integrity checks. The original-app fixture in `tests/fixtures/legacy-bd25f38.json` was generated by interacting with commit bd25f38, using synthetic workouts, not by inventing its saved schema. The browser test resumes and finishes the original Strength session and preserves the original Muscle history byte-for-byte.

The final browser scenario runs all four selected sections in one combined day. It also opens a completed activity and encrypts, validates, restores and reloads a backup containing new goals and conditioning. Existing suites cover restore failure/rollback, imports, calendar files, session controls, focus, and widths from 195 to 1440 CSS pixels. The engine suites cover 48-session estimate simulations, kit constraints, weekly targets and deterministic recovery decisions. These are bounded test cases, not a proof of zero defects.

Manual Chromium inspection at 390 × 844 covered fresh setup, Today, start, focus and the full workout list. Physical iPhone keyboards, Safari/WebKit and locked-device notification delivery were not tested in this run.

## Every review item

Done means the reported user-facing behavior has an implementation and relevant checks. Partial identifies a narrower implementation or unverified portion. Excluded retains the owner's PLAN.md scope; some excluded areas have incidental tests or prior changes, but are not certified here. Evidence names refer to `tests/<name>.test.cjs` or `tests/<name>-browser.js` and the wave result documents.

## Radical proposals

| Proposal | Status | Implementation / remaining limit |
|---|---|---|
| K1 One app | Done | Shared navigation, Settings and session presentation; legacy stores retained as required. |
| K2 Storage core | Excluded | Explicit storage-architecture exclusion. |
| K3 Next set | Done | Default focus card, steppers, rest view, List/swipe, plate display and Ladder controls; platform alert limits remain under item 73. |
| K4 Performance model | Partial | Smoothed estimates/ranges, calibrated RIR, noise-aware trends and adjustments; personal rep-max curve fitting is not implemented. |
| K5 Weekly targets | Partial | Targets, caps, movement rankings, fixed order, calendar spacing and conditioning carry are implemented. Arbitrarily chosen adjacent days cannot guarantee 48-hour separation, and every individual choice does not display a study sample/effect size. |
| K6 Safety layer | Done | Health/life-stage screen, illness/red flags, movement mapping and Ladder pain holds. Planning guidance is not a clinical clearance. |
| K7 Conditioning | Done | Setup, rank, placement, timer, outside activity, recovery estimate and 12-week progress. |
| K8 Equipment | Done | Shared inventory/rack/bar model, effective loads and loadable progression. |
| K9 Ladder logging | Done | Timer, sides, difficulty/setup, proof rules, RIR and balance blocks. |
| K10 Portable data | Done within scope | CSV/import, coach summary, calendar and encrypted portable backups. Cloud sync/native health explicitly excluded by PLAN.md. |
| K11 Hosting origin | Excluded | Explicit hosting exclusion. |
| K12 Engineering architecture | Excluded | Explicit refactor/CI exclusion. |
| K13 Two levels of copy | Partial | Collapsed explanations, measured compact Today/Customize, quick start/reference split. Evidence libraries remain separate; no universal per-sentence or live-link audit. |
| K14 Two-tap start | Done | Minimal first setup, optional daily check-in, later tuning. |

## Known limits retained

The original exclusions include long-history storage/load limits, multi-tab writes and shared hosting origin. New logs/goals have bounded additions, but this work does not resolve the excluded storage architecture. Keep downloadable backups. Platform suspension can delay interval/rest cues; the app says so. None of the validation results establishes that all possible UI or data defects are absent.
